strongest_angle: Google's October 28, 2026 announcement of the Connected Apps Platform preview brings over 50 external partners like Adobe and Peloton directly into Gemini and Search.

key_facts.fact: On October 28, 2026, Google announced the Connected Apps Platform preview to give developers a single place to build and manage apps for Search and the Gemini app.
Google stated on October 28, 2026, that more than 50 Connected Apps are already live across Gemini and Google Search from partners including Adobe, Experian, Localiza, and Peloton.

TechCrunch reported on October 28, 2026, that Google has over 50 Connected Apps available in Gemini from partners such as Adobe, Experian, Localiza, and Peloton alongside its own services like Workspace, Photos, YouTube Music, and Google Home.
